title: A sharp mixing-sensitive perturbation bound for the lifetime policy contrast
checked_scope: Finite invariant Markov transition models with two mixing kernels, a fixed zero-mass initial policy contrast and bounded state earnings.
significance: Improves the source's generic discount-squared transition-error bound using both kernels' mixing rates and proves the resulting factor-two contrast bound sharp in a two-state model.
